title: The Machine That Thinks It Knows

collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A philosopher asks whether distant people might construct devices that answer questions, imitate conversation, or make decisions.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A philosopher asks whether distant people might construct devices that answer questions, imitate conversation, or make decisions.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children invent a machine that remembers every recipe and never tires of questions.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A teacher asks whether an answer is useful if its reasoning cannot be checked.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The group invents an adviser that confidently misidentifies every bird; everyone laughs, then discusses error.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A villager worries that people might trust a device too much simply because it sounds certain.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The council decides that imagined makers and users would still owe others care and accountability.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The philosopher wonders whether some decisions should never be delegated; the debate continues past sunset.
